status: Explicit post-hoc follow-up to the positive-but-ineligible NY retest result; all periods reused, no independent validation
hypothesis: A protective stop beyond the actual rejection and a predetermined opening-range Fibonacci projection may improve net payoff without waiting for a full-range three-R move
budget: Exactly two confirmation routes, fixed1.618 projection and0.25ATR rejection buffer. No projection, session, stop, trend or payoff tuning.
source_clock_and_range: Identical session_breakout_protocol.json: NY weekdays09:30-10:00 range, width1-4 frozen ATR14, previous completed4h EMA50 trend, first aligned closing breakout10:00-13:00, flat16:00, IANA DST
target: Range high plus1.618 opening-range widths for long; range low minus1.618 widths for short. Freeze when range completes; round toward entry. No target that depends on a future swing.
target_visit: Consume setup if the breakout candle or any later armed candle already touched the fixed projected target, including the confirmation candle; no stale target entry
stop: Beyond the first-touch candle extreme by0.25 frozen opening-range ATR; include the next candle extreme when it supplies confirmation; round outward. No stop adjustment after submission.

candidates.name: ny_fib_same_candle
candidates.entry: Same first boundary touch/rejection as original retest, using the new fixed projection and rejection stop

candidates.name: ny_fib_two_candle
candidates.entry: Use first-touch rejection when valid; otherwise allow exactly the immediately following closed15m candle to reclaim the broken boundary in a directional body. Both routes require close outside boundary and within half a range width, current trend agreement and original range-stop intact.

one_setup: First trend-aligned closing breakout consumes the date. Retest must first touch within4 later15m bars; a fifth bar can only confirm a touch on the fourth. Pending confirmation expires after its immediately next candle or at entry-window end. Payoff skip, stop breach, target visit or trend loss consumes the setup.
execution: Unchanged0.25% equity modeled risk,95% notional cap,max1BTC,.001BTC step,.07% fee eachside,2tick directional slippage,.25ATR gap sizing reserve,1.5 minimum modeled net reward/risk,5m stop-first replay including entry subbar, actual carried-position funding. Market next open, no same-close fill or pyramiding.
selection: Among candidates passing all criteria, largest minimum across the two accounts of net divided by5m-close drawdown
publication: Record all outcomes and post-hoc selection. Passing earns only an experimental Pine prototype; native, venue-exact and prospective verification remain outstanding. No promotion or weaker criteria when candidates fail.
